subject: Post-call: Onramp plan, success criteria, and final readout timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@datafoundry.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Onramp plan, success criteria, and final readout timeline

Hi Alice — great speaking earlier. Quick recap and proposed onramp (so we’re aligned before we lock dates):

Summary of what we heard
- Goal: prove Redwood can serve production prompts for DataFoundry’s search-assist product with predictable latency and cost before Q1 rollout.
- Scope: inference + embeddings for two model flavors (open Llama-like variant + quantized 8-bit variant) against a 20k sample test set provided by you.

Proposed POC structure (please confirm):
- Length: 4 weeks (proposed kickoff week starting Nov 24).
- Kickoff: hands-on technical kickoff (1.5h) to align infra and dataset.
- Cadence: 30-minute weekly syncs (Tuesdays, 10:00 AM PST) + async updates in the shared doc.
- Final readout: executive demo + results deck in the last week of the POC (target week of Dec 22).

Success criteria (mutually measurable):
1) Latency: p95 end-to-end inference latency <= 200ms for single-turn queries on dedicated test load.
2) Cost: per-token inference cost runs below the threshold we discussed (target <$0.002/token at expected QPS).
3) Accuracy: model answers meet the pass-rate threshold on your QA checklist (>= 88% correctness on the 2k validation subset).
4) Reliability: no more than one incident causing >2x latency spike during the run.

Owners / roles
- Redwood: Marissa (sales, escalation), Karthik (RSE / infra lead), Monica (CS / onboarding).
- DataFoundry: Alice (Product owner), Martin (CTO, readout stakeholder), Bob (procurement contact — if different, please confirm).

Immediate next steps (action items):
- Alice: confirm kickoff date (we suggested week of Nov 24) and share the 20k sample dataset + any PII constraints.
- Marissa: send the mutual action plan and the POC playbook (attached).
- Karthik: will share infra checklist and firewall/IP allowlist for the cluster before kickoff.
- Procurement: we’ll share a DocuSign MSA/POC addendum for signature; let us know preferred PO process.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, redwood_poc_playbook.pdf (two small docs — one is a one-page success rubric).

If that looks good I’ll draft a one-page cadence + send a DocuSign link for the addendum.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

On behalf of Redwood — happy to be tactical on timelines and procurement so we can get your readout before end of year.

From: Alice Chen <alice@datafoundry.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Onramp plan, success criteria, and final readout timeline

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. A few quick items from our side:

1) Kickoff availability: we have a major planning offsite the week of Nov 24; team asked if we can shift kickoff to Wed, Nov 26 (morning PST) instead of the 24th. Is that workable?
2) Procurement: our procurement lead is Bob Sterling (bob@datafoundry.com) — looping him on this thread. He’ll need the MSA and a short commercial summary for our legal team.
3) Security: we’ll need SOC 2 evidence and an inventory of where logs/metrics are retained during the POC (retention period). If you could attach an excerpt or point us to the security pack that would help speed review.
4) Readout stakeholders: Martin (CTO) and Lina (Head of Search) will want a short technical appendix included in the final deck.

We’re comfortable with the success criteria; the only ask is to clarify how you’ll measure per-token cost for cached vs non-cached traffic (we use a mix of cold and warm prefixes).

If Nov 26 works for Redwood, I can block a 90-minute kickoff and ensure data access approvals are in place.

Best,
Alice
Alice Chen | Senior Product Manager | DataFoundry
alice@datafoundry.com | +1 650-555-7789

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@datafoundry.com>, Bob Sterling <bob@datafoundry.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Onramp plan, success criteria, and final readout timeline

Thanks Alice — Nov 26 (Wednesday) works for us. Updated plan below and a few clarifications on the cost and security asks.

Updated dates and cadence
- Kickoff (technical): Wed, Nov 26, 09:30–11:00 AM PST — we’ll cover infra, dataset handoff, and test-run checklist.
- Weekly syncs: Wednesdays 30-min, 09:30 AM PST (quick health & blockers).
- Final readout: target Wed, Dec 24 (we’ll plan the readout week two business days earlier if you prefer Dec 22 — happy to align once we confirm holidays).

Cost measurement note
- We’ll provide a breakdown in the playbook for cached vs non-cached accounting. For the POC we’ll run two measurement windows: a cold-start window (first 500 unique prefixes) and a steady-state window (daily peak window). We’ll report both numbers in the final deck so you have clear apples-to-apples comparisons.

Security & compliance
- Attached is the POC security excerpt (SOC 2 summary & log retention notes are in the security appendix of the playbook). If your InfoSec needs the full pack we can provide an NDA'd dropbox or arrange a short SOC2 walk-through with our security lead.

Action items (updated)
- Marissa: send DocuSign link for the POC addendum and confirm kickoff agenda by EOD Mon Nov 23.
- Bob: if you can confirm procurement timing and the PO workflow we’ll route the addendum accordingly.
- Karthik: see infra checklist below and flag any special networking requirements.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, redwood_poc_playbook.pdf (security appendix included).

Thanks — will set the DocuSign and calendar invites once Bob confirms PO path.

Marissa
(on mobile)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alice Chen <alice@datafoundry.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Bob Sterling <bob@datafoundry.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Onramp plan, success criteria, and final readout timeline

Quick technical checklist ahead of the Nov 26 kickoff (summary):

1) Network & access
- Please provide a list of IPs (or CIDR) for any agents that will call Redwood, and we’ll generate an allowlist for the POC nodes.
- If you prefer we can host a short-lived VPC peering demo in your cloud account — advise which you prefer.

2) Dataset prep
- Send the 20k sample compressed (gzip) with the column mapping doc (example file: sample_2k_preview.csv). We’ll validate via checksum and run a small validation job during kickoff.

3) Metrics & observability
- We’ll enable token-level cost logging and a per-route latency dashboard. We will not ship any raw PII out of your environment; logs are pseudonymized by default in the POC. Retention: 14 days for debugging metrics unless you request longer.

4) Test harness
- Karthik will drop a simple load generator and a lightweight evaluation harness (accuracy + latency scripts) into the shared workspace prior to kickoff. We should agree on the steady-state load (suggest 50 QPS at 75% concurrency to approximate peak).

Attachment: infra_onboarding_steps.md (I’ll upload this to the shared drive and add step-by-step commands).

I’ll be on the kickoff to run the infra portion — Monica will own onboarding and monitoring during the run.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | RSE, Redwood Inference
